kafka.identity: preserve node.id and KRaft cluster UUID; never auto-format

elasticsearch.identity: retain cluster UUID; initial_master_nodes only for accepted first bootstrap

installation.strategy: verified immutable AMI or offline release artifact via accepted S3 path
installation.release_lock_status: five publisher-checksum-pinned archives verified locally; detached signatures, offline OS/Python and full connectors await acceptance

lifecycle.restart_policy: data daemons on-failure; lease-owned drivers Restart=no
lifecycle.driver_stop_proof: accepted owner/generation/epoch unit identity + inactive units + empty cgroups + all Spark masters/workers observed
planned_stop_order: verify DB backups/remote copies and required snapshots
observe stopped before EC2 stop or removal
lifecycle.recovery: preserve EBS and IDs; validate release and mount; ZooKeeper, Spark quorum, Kafka/ES recovery; health and data verification before lease-owned writers

deployment_blockers: detached signatures and complete offline OS/Python/connector closure
accepted AMI and real mount UUIDs/inventory/PKI/secrets
remote native driver/lease fencing and signed cgroup stop evidence
actual PID1 systemd restart/data preservation and backup/restore acceptance
auxiliary observation/proxy transport and reboot secret delivery acceptance
